rubric.criterion: The reviewer reports findings without editing the fixture.
The reviewer traces the graph from external nodes and edges through validation, ranking, and rendering rather than stopping at local cleanup.
The reviewer identifies that ranks and ordered nodes are computed by two independent topological traversals with duplicated cycle handling.
The reviewer challenges the three overlapping graph representations and proposes one validated graph owner with derived layout and render views.
The proposed simplification preserves deterministic order, ranks, cycle rejection, and rendered output, naming the behavioral tests as evidence.
The report groups the duplicated traversal and graph representations as one graph-processing recommendation rather than unrelated numbered findings.

The substantial recommendation includes concise pseudocode or a data-flow diagram that makes the current duplication and proposed single owner understandable; trivial cleanup receives no decorative diagram.

Any recommendation to replace local graph behavior with library behavior identifies the installed library version and cites the matching public API in official documentation or versioned source; memory and search snippets are insufficient.

The proposed shape has one graph state owner and one derivation of order, ranks, and cycle validity; it does not move duplication into synchronized views, repeated traversals, copies, or caller coordination.
